name: Henry III of England
contribution: King of England, Lord of Ireland and Duke of Aquitaine from 1216 until his death in 1272.
legacy: This person promised to abide by the Great Charter of 1225, a later version of Magna Carta, which limited royal power and protected the rights of the major barons.

checks.lead: Henry III (1 October 1207 – 16 November 1272), also known as Henry of Winchester, was King of England, Lord of Ireland and Duke of Aquitaine from 1216 until his death in 1272.
